item.title: [+1] India-Canada trade pact talks to conclude in December
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 8 reports from BusinessLine, Telegraph India, Maritime Gateway and 4 more. Related: “US mid-term results unlikely to speed up India trade deal as tariff uncertainties persist”. Turn: earlier readings (10 Nov) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Hindustan Copper Q2 FY27 Results: Net Profit Jumps 179% to Rs 519.54 Crore, Revenue Rises 64% to Rs 1,175.24 Crore
item.description:
Signal: higher metal prices. 4 reports from FXStreet, Indian Masterminds, The Tribune and 1 more. Related: “India Approves INR 2,814 Crore CAPEX Scheme To Boost Domestic Lithium And Nickel Processing”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Input costs rise

Why it matters: Rising metal prices lift Indian steel, aluminium and zinc producers while raising input costs for automakers, builders and capital-goods makers.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
